isomorphisms.name: Wilsonian Renormalization / Effective Field Theory
isomorphisms.domain_b: Wilsonian renormalization group / effective field theory construction
isomorphisms.chi_law: Each section supplies the condition required by the next, following a dependency chain identical to a known physics process
isomorphisms.physics_process: Wilsonian renormalization: start with boundary conditions/symmetries, detect anomalies/divergences, identify field content, define coarse-graining transformation, derive flow equations, verify consistency, apply to critical system, observe universality, state regime of validity
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: The paper's argument sequence: premises → audit → substrate → method → equation → verification → demonstration → convergence → self-audit
isomorphisms.prediction: If the mapping holds, the self-audit section should function as a 'regime of validity' statement, naming cutoffs and failure modes rather than merely summarizing weaknesses
physics_process_steps: Establish boundary conditions, symmetries, conservation laws
Detect anomalies, divergences, breakdown of prior model
Identify field content, degrees of freedom, state space
Define coarse-graining / renormalization transformation
Derive beta functions, flow equations, effective action
Verify consistency, symmetry preservation, fixed-point analysis
Apply to one physical system (critical point, scattering case)
Observe universality class / fixed point across systems
State regime of validity, cutoff scale, error terms, known limitations
mapped_text_steps: Section I: Premises — establish what must hold before inquiry begins
Section II: Reverse Audit — show where naturalism fails to self-close
Section III: Substrate — identify shared structural variables (10 factors)
Section IV: Method — define Audit → Map → Model → Verify process
Section V: Equation — derive Coherence ODE from three domains
Section VI: Formal Verification — Lean 4, adversarial discriminator, zero sorry
Section VII: Demonstration — solve measurement problem with triadic composition
Section VIII: Convergence — same sentence appears across 70 domains
Section IX: Self-Audit — load-bearing, suggestive, overreached, kill conditions
preserved_transitions: Boundary conditions → anomaly detection (Premises → Reverse Audit)
Anomaly detection → substrate identification (Reverse Audit → Substrate)
Verification → application to hard case (Verification → Demonstration)
missing_transitions: The physics process includes explicit 'coarse-graining' or 'integrating out degrees of freedom' which has no direct analog in the paper's method section
broken_correspondences: The paper's 'Verification' section (Lean 4) is more about formal proof than consistency checks in the RG sense; RG verification is about symmetry preservation and fixed-point stability, not theorem proving

The 'Demonstration' section (measurement problem) is a single application, but RG typically applies to a specific physical system with quantitative predictions; the paper's demonstration is conceptual
The 'Convergence' section claims universality across 70 domains, but RG universality is mathematically derived from fixed-point analysis, not empirical survey
isomorphisms.notes: This is the strongest mapping in the paper. The author explicitly states the dependency chain and invites the reader to identify the physics process. The mapping is structural, not metaphorical, but some steps (verification, demonstration) have different operational meanings in the two domains. The density score is high because 8 of 9 stages map cleanly, but the mapping is not one-to-one at the level of specific operations.

isomorphisms.name: Coherence ODE as Driven-Dissipative System
isomorphisms.chi_law: dC/dt = O·G(1-C) - S·C maps to dE/dt = P_in - γE
isomorphisms.physics_process: Driven-dissipative system: external power input maintains order against dissipation; without input, energy decays exponentially to zero
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Coherence requires external grace input (O); without it, coherence decays exponentially (sin term); floor requires external source
isomorphisms.prediction: The equation predicts that any closed system (O=0) will decay to zero coherence; the Genesis data shows a non-zero floor, requiring O>0
physics_process_steps: System has internal dissipation rate γ
External power input P_in maintains order
Steady state energy E_ss = P_in/γ
Without input, E(t) = E_0 e^{-γt}
Floor at zero without external source
mapped_text_steps: System has internal decay term S (sin/entropy)
External grace input O maintains coherence
Steady state coherence C_ss = O·G/(S + O·G)
Without grace, C(t) = C_0 e^{-S·t}
Genesis data shows floor at 93, requiring O>0
preserved_transitions: Decay term → exponential decay without input
Input removal → decay to floor (zero or non-zero)
missing_transitions: The physics process has a clear energy conservation constraint; the theological model has no equivalent conservation law
broken_correspondences: The physics term G(1-C) in the coherence equation is not standard in driven-dissipative systems; it introduces a saturation effect that is more biological (logistic) than thermodynamic
The 'floor' in Genesis data (93 years) is not predicted by the physics equation alone; it requires an additional constant term not present in the standard driven-dissipative form
isomorphisms.notes: The mapping is strong for the core dynamic (decay without input, maintenance with input) but breaks down in the specific functional form. The equation is actually a hybrid of driven-dissipative and logistic dynamics, not a pure thermodynamic analog.

isomorphisms.name: Triadic Composition as Measurement Problem Solution
isomorphisms.domain_b: Quantum measurement problem / von Neumann chain
isomorphisms.chi_law: T = A ∘ L ∘ G maps to three functions in a single closed operation resolving the infinite regress of observers
isomorphisms.physics_process: Von Neumann measurement chain: system → device → observer → ... infinite regress; no natural termination
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Triadic composition (G generates possibility, L structures, A actualizes) terminates the regress by making the operation internal and closed
isomorphisms.prediction: The triadic structure should be the minimal self-contained actualization operation; removing any function should reopen the regress
physics_process_steps: Quantum system in superposition (multiple possibilities)
Measurement device interacts, but becomes part of superposition
Observer measures device, but becomes part of superposition
Chain never terminates; no natural collapse mechanism
mapped_text_steps: G generates possibility field (Father)
L structures possibilities into intelligible form (Son/Logos)
A actualizes one outcome (Spirit)
Composition A∘L∘G is closed; no external verifier needed
missing_transitions: The physics process has no analog for the 'generation' function G; quantum mechanics takes the Hilbert space as given
broken_correspondences: The mapping claims that the triadic composition solves the measurement problem, but it does not specify how the composition physically operates (e.g., what is the mechanism of actualization?)
The von Neumann chain is about measurement, not creation; the theological triad includes creation (G generates possibility) which goes beyond the measurement context
isomorphisms.notes: This is the most ambitious mapping in the paper. It claims to solve a 93-year-old physics problem with a theological structure. The mapping is structurally interesting but the operational details are missing. The paper acknowledges this is a demonstration, not a full solution.

isomorphisms.name: Reverse Audit as Anomaly Detection
isomorphisms.domain_b: Anomaly detection in effective field theory
isomorphisms.chi_law: Six points where naturalism fails to close its own circle map to six divergences or anomalies in a quantum field theory
isomorphisms.physics_process: Effective field theory: at certain scales, the theory produces divergences or anomalies that signal the need for a more fundamental description or new degrees of freedom
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Naturalism fails at consciousness, mathematical effectiveness, morality, information origin, fine-tuning, initial conditions — six points where the theory cannot self-close
physics_process_steps: Theory works well at low energies
At high energies, divergences appear
Divergences signal missing degrees of freedom
New physics required at higher scale
mapped_text_steps: Naturalism works well for empirical phenomena
At foundational questions, six points fail
Failures signal missing grounding
Theology provides the missing substrate
preserved_transitions: Working regime → failure regime (empirical success → foundational failure)
missing_transitions: Physics has a precise mathematical characterization of divergences (renormalization group); the paper's six points are qualitative
Physics has a systematic method for resolving anomalies (new degrees of freedom, new symmetries); the paper's resolution is not systematic
broken_correspondences: The six leak points are not structurally analogous to each other; they are a heterogeneous list (consciousness is different from fine-tuning)
Physics anomalies are scale-dependent; the paper's leaks are not scale-dependent
Physics anomalies are resolved by extending the theory; the paper's resolution is to replace naturalism with theology, not extend it
isomorphisms.notes: This mapping is suggestive but thin. The general pattern (theory works in one regime, fails at boundaries) is common, but the specific structural details do not align. The paper's six points are not derived from a single formalism, unlike anomalies in QFT.

isomorphisms.name: Master Equation Product Form as Phase Space Constraint
isomorphisms.domain_b: Phase space volume constraint in statistical mechanics
isomorphisms.chi_law: Product form means zero any factor collapses coherence, analogous to phase space volume going to zero when any constraint is violated
isomorphisms.physics_process: Statistical mechanics: phase space volume is product of independent degrees of freedom; if any degree of freedom is constrained to a single point, volume collapses to zero
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Coherence requires all ten variables non-zero; zero any one and χ = 0 (product collapse)
physics_process_steps: Phase space volume V = ∏ Δq_i Δp_i
If any degree of freedom is fixed (Δ = 0), volume collapses
System cannot explore phase space; dynamics constrained
mapped_text_steps: Coherence χ = ∏ (G, M, E, S, T, K, R, Q, F, C)
If any variable is zero, χ = 0
System is decoherent; no dynamics possible
preserved_transitions: Product form → zero factor collapses the whole
missing_transitions: Phase space volume is a measure of accessible states; coherence is not a measure of accessible states
Physics has no analog for the specific ten variables or their theological interpretation
broken_correspondences: The product form in physics arises from independence of degrees of freedom; the paper's ten variables are not independent (they are coupled in the Master Equation)
Phase space collapse is a geometric constraint; coherence collapse is a logical/structural constraint
The paper's product form is asserted, not derived from any underlying dynamics
isomorphisms.notes: This is a thin mapping. The product form is mathematically similar, but the physical meaning is different. The paper uses the product form as a logical constraint (all factors must be present), not as a geometric measure.
